points.label: Order and appointment
points.left: The LORD addresses the psalmist’s Lord, promises rule, swears an unchanging oath, and names a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
points.right: Hebrews describes high-priestly appointment, recalls Aaron, quotes the Son and priestly sayings, and says God named Christ a high priest after Melchizedek’s order.

payload.posture: Read both passages while keeping each speaker, setting, action, and later argument in its own setting.

rightEvidence.title: Hebrews applies the saying to Christ after discussing Aaron and appointment

payload.tension: Hebrews places the psalm’s saying inside an argument about Christ’s appointed priesthood.
payload.title: The sworn saying and Christ’s appointment
